data: NVIDIA's net income was about $9.75 billion in fiscal 2022 (the year ended January 30, 2022) and about $60.92 billion in fiscal 2024 (the year ended January 28, 2024). That is an increase of roughly $51.17 billion, or about 525%, meaning net income grew to approximately 6.25 times its fiscal 2022 level. The jump was driven mainly by surging data center demand for AI-related GPUs, which lifted fiscal 2024 revenue to $60.9 billion from $26.9 billion in fiscal 2022.
